contexts.text: When this knowledge is taken away from them... they are then of gross and dull mind.
Hence dullness in things of thought and judgment, and skilfulness in the things of the body and the world.
Just as it is with men in the world, who are dull and stupid as to spiritual truths in proportion as they indulge the palate, and the blandishments of the tactile things of the body.
Oh, how great and terrible is the dullness of the age! CL 481.
In the Christian Societies in the World of Spirits... there is a dullness and thick darkness in the things of salvation, almost like that of a talking parrot.
They despise others in comparison with themselves in a certain kind of dullness...
